page.overview:
Who is Impa?

In the original , appears in the game as an Old Woman, however she is only named in the game's instruction manual. When Hyrule was under attack by Ganon's forces in , Princess Zelda ordered her old nursemaid Impa to secretly flee and find the one who could save them. Ganon soon found out and sent his minions after Impa. Though she managed to stay out of their reach for a long time, she was eventually captured. However, she was saved by a strange boy named Link who managed to chase away Ganon's henchmen. Knowing that this was the one she had been looking for, Impa told him the whole story and asked him to go save Princess Zelda, therefore starting his adventure.

In , six years after the events of , Impa had resumed her normal duties. One day, Link came to her because he was worried about a strange mark that had appeared on his left hand. When Impa saw the mark, she was initially startled, but quickly regained her composure. She then took Link to a door in North Castle that only the members of her family knew how to open. In the room behind the door lay a princess of Hyrule from ancient times (not the Zelda from the first game) and before Link could ask any questions, Impa told the princess' story. When she was done telling, she picked up six Crystals and a scroll lying on a stand next to the altar and gave them to Link. She explained that these items were handed down in her family for generations while waiting for the one who was chosen by destiny to save the princess. She implored Link to follow his destiny and save the princess, to which he agreed.

In , the character has a dramatic difference in appearance and background compared to earlier (and later) games, and is depicted as a much younger, highly disciplined warrior. This incarnation of Impa was born and raised in Kakariko Village, the village of the Sheikah. She was selected as Princess Zelda's attendant and personal bodyguard, and likely left her village around that time, giving it to the people of other races. Though Hyrule Castle became her new home, she still kept a watching eye over Kakariko, but most of her attention went to the young princess. Until Link came along, Impa was the only one who believed her visions.

Link met Impa for the first time in Hyrule Castle as a child, where, after meeting Zelda, she taught him "Zelda's Lullaby", and immediately sees the young hero's potential. She then helped him leave the castle. Outside, she advised Link to head to Death Mountain to find the next Spiritual Stones She barely managed to escape Ganondorf and stayed in hiding with the princess for seven years. It is very likely that she was the one who raised Princess Zelda during those growing years and taught her what she had to know to pass off as a Sheikah like herself to become Sheik. Impa also kept protecting Kakariko Village to her best effort.
